note: Order from the 1-ID-C panel (cs03, CS-Studio screenshot; 'Last update 11-12-2026' printed on it, the 2026-10-20 phone photo p13 showed layout date 8-31-2026; no differences in element order found). Panel sections: [IC1,IC2,Slit 1] [fourC] [Beam Conditioning System: IC3, L1-L6, AttenC, Slit 2, IC4] | dotted line | [LabMotion SMS, DBA, Tomo D1, Stop, Shield, Varex D2, Lens7]. elements.name: fourC
elements.notes: Four-circle diffractometer ('4C' on the overview cs01). Motors as supplied by the user: TABLE motors (cs07) 1idc:m76 and 1idcAMCI:m2..m6 (AMCI stepper controller); CIRCLE motors (cs08) 1idc:m40, m74, m75, m85, m86. The motor panels show no axis names, so the role of each (which is omega, chi, phi, 2theta ...) is NOT known. mpe_bluesky has a commented-out FourC('1idc:') device. Per the user (2026-11-13) these motors are not needed for most workflows: they are listed as table/circle groups only, with no axis assigned to any motor.

elements.notes: samC (SMSCDevice) in mpe_bluesky. MOTORS CHECKED 2026-11-13 against the CS-Studio display (1idc_SMS_stack.bob: samZ m25, samY m26, samX m27, Rx m28, Rz m29, Labmotion = 1idELMO:m1, LabMotion_TransX m31; Sample_Wheel_in_C m30) and the log-panel motor descriptions (samXC m25, samYC m26, samZC m27, rxc m28, rzc m29, rotXC m31): same motor set; two labelling conflicts (x/z, m31) are recorded under controls.conflicts, not resolved by guessing. Screen cs09 'LabMotion_SMS': axes (+Y) up, (+Z) beam direction, (+X) into the screen; buttons Rx, Rz, samX, samZ, samY, Labmotion, LabMotion_TransX; CAUTION printed: 'motor orientation valid only when Labmotion = 0' (the Labmotion rotation). The same screen reports IOC status for 1idSP5 (pg5 camera) and 1idVarex1 (Varex D2): both 'IOC is down' in the screenshot. A small 'Labmotion' button sits below it on the panel.

elements.name: Tomo D1
elements.notes: Green bar on the panel (probably in-beam indicator). Profile camera pg5 (1idSP5:, hutch C) is presumably the camera on it (unconfirmed). Panel draws a green bar on the beam line between DBA and Stop; the 'Tomo D1' button is below the line. The IOC Control tab Detector(B/C) (cs10) lists 'Tomo (1idSP5:)' = the pg5 camera (profile hutch C). The CS-Studio display button 'Tomo D1' opens the 1idSP5 ADSpinnaker panel (PGR_GS3_U3_23S6M; also a pointGrey viewer 1idPG5) beside the motors m77/m79/m84, so pg5 is on this element (display record, 2026-11-13).
